source_summary: Muted ink-and-wash Chinese riverside landscape with misty distant mountains, textured right hillside, tree groves, a waterside village, boat, bridge, travelers, and foreground banks. No calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture are included as motifs.

motifs.name: distant_right_mountain_range
motifs.description: Pale blue-gray distant mountain silhouettes along the upper right horizon, isolated from the darker foreground hillside below.
must_preserve: subtle tonal layering between nearer and farther peaks

motifs.name: textured_right_hillside
motifs.description: Large sloping hillside on the right with diagonal dry-brush striations, dotted vegetation, and dark crest accents, excluding the pale mountains behind it.
must_preserve: scattered dark shrub dots along the ridge
pale wash transitions down the slope
small clustered tree marks near the upper edge

motifs.name: misty_midground_pine_grove
motifs.description: Central midground grove of upright pines and sparse trees emerging from mist, set between the foreground village trees and the distant hills.
must_preserve: soft gray wash haze around the bases

motifs.name: left_willow_grove
motifs.description: Dense left and central grove of willows and leafy trees behind and around the village, with arching trunks and drooping foliage masses.
must_preserve: thin visible trunks and forked branches

motifs.name: waterside_cottage_cluster
motifs.description: Cluster of thatched riverside cottages at the lower center-left, including roof planes, walls, small windows, fencing, and tiny figures immediately beside the buildings.
must_preserve: thatched roof geometry and parallel hatch strokes

motifs.name: large_riverside_tree
motifs.description: Prominent dark riverside broadleaf tree rising beside the cottages, with leaning trunks and a heavy rounded canopy over the water edge.
must_preserve: contrast between dark canopy and pale water/mist

motifs.name: small_river_boat
motifs.description: Narrow boat in the lower center with a standing punter and seated passenger, surrounded by minimal horizontal water strokes.
must_preserve: thin rippling water lines around the boat

motifs.name: footbridge_with_travelers
motifs.description: Low arched wooden footbridge and adjacent riverbank path on the lower right, including walkers and pack animal figures but excluding the large lower-right rocks.
must_preserve: muddy bank wash and grass tufts

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
